sam: Quick sync - I attempted the JS SDK quickstart on Deno and Bun for a partner demo, ran into a few edge runtime quirks.
ira: what showed up?
sam: Deno: `Uncaught Error: package.json exports do not contain ./deno` when using the README default import. TS also warns about missing default export. Bun: intermittent auth failures because `crypto.subtle` is undefined in older Bun. Also response body parsing blew up due to different stream shapes.
ben: sounds like we shipped mostly Node-centric examples. Short fixes: add an explicit `redwood/deno` export, publish an ESM deno build with types, and provide a tiny runtime-adapters module.
maria: runtime-adapters should export: isDeno,isBun,isNode plus fetchNormalize and subtleShim. subtleShim should dynamically import a tiny fallback only if `globalThis.crypto?.subtle` is absent so Node bundles stay tiny.
sam: package.json exports snippet we can use: "exports": { "./deno": "./dist/deno/index.mjs", ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" } }`
ira: Deno consumers also need d.ts - publish `dist/deno/index.d.ts` and make sure Deno picks it up. Add a short example in README showing `import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno'` and a deno.json in examples/deno-quickstart.
ben: For fetch differences, change body parsing to try `response.json()` then `response.arrayBuffer()` before low-level stream ops. That should handle Bun and Edge runtimes.
ci-bot: nightly deno quickstart job failed: https://ci.internal/xxxxx (shows exports resolve error)
maria: I'll open a small PR that adds the deno entry, example quickstart, and a unit test that runs `deno run --allow-net examples/deno-quickstart/main.ts`.
sam: I'll implement runtime-adapters + subtle shim and add tests that mock missing subtle in Bun-like environments.
ira: please add a compatibility table to the SDK README listing exact supported Deno/Bun versions, and a troubleshooting snippet: `If you see "exports do not contain ./deno", use import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno' or upgrade SDK >= x.y.z`.
ben: also add CI matrix jobs for node(18,20), deno(>=1.34), bun nightly to catch regressions.
ci-bot: created issue #842: "SDK: Deno/Bun compatibility - deno export, runtime adapters, webcrypto shim, fetch normalization" assigned to sam,maria.
sam: thanks all 44d will link PR when ready.
